fsm_states_controller.name: RESET
fsm_states_controller.description: After PCIe Conventional Reset, FLR, NVM Subsystem Reset, or CC.EN 1→0 Controller Reset. CSTS.RDY = 0; all I/O queues deleted; CC, AQA, ASQ, ACQ ready to accept host configuration.

fsm_states_controller.name: INITIALIZING
fsm_states_controller.description: CC.EN 0→1 detected by controller; controller validates CC.CSS, CC.MPS, CC.IOSQES, CC.IOCQES, AQA, ASQ, ACQ; initializes Admin SQ/CQ ring pointers; readies completion path; sets CSTS.RDY = 1.

fsm_states_controller.name: READY
fsm_states_controller.description: CSTS.RDY = 1; controller services Admin SQ doorbell writes; host can issue Create I/O Submission/Completion Queue, Identify, Set Features, etc.

fsm_states_controller.name: RUNNING
fsm_states_controller.description: At least one I/O SQ/CQ pair created; controller services I/O SQ doorbell writes; data transfer via PCIe MRd/MWr TLPs to host PRP/SGL buffers.

fsm_states_controller.name: SHUTDOWN_PROCESSING
fsm_states_controller.description: Host wrote CC.SHN = 01b (normal) or 10b (abrupt). Controller stops accepting new commands, drains outstanding work, flushes write cache (normal), updates CSTS.SHST = 01b.

fsm_states_controller.name: SHUTDOWN_COMPLETE
fsm_states_controller.description: CSTS.SHST = 10b; controller is safe to power off. Resuming requires CC.EN 1→0 → reset, then re-enable.

fsm_states_controller.name: PROCESSING_PAUSED
fsm_states_controller.description: CSTS.PP = 1; temporary pause during e.g. firmware activation; commands queued but not processed.

fsm_states_controller.name: FATAL
fsm_states_controller.description: CSTS.CFS = 1; fatal internal error; controller stops processing; host should NVM Subsystem Reset or Function-Level Reset.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: PCIe Conventional Reset / FLR / NSSR / CC.EN 1→0
fsm_transitions_major.description: All transient state lost; persistent-feature values reload.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: Create I/O CQ + Create I/O SQ pair succeed
fsm_transitions_major.description: Controller now services I/O queue doorbells.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_PCI_ENUM
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: BIOS / OS enumerates the PCI Function; assigns BAR0/BAR1; class code 010802h (NVMe) detected; load NVMe driver.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_READ_CAP_VS
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Read CAP (offset 0h, 64-bit) and VS (offset 8h, 32-bit); verify version ≥ 1.0; capture CAP.TO, CAP.DSTRD, CAP.MQES, CAP.MPSMIN/MAX, CAP.CSS, CAP.NSSRS.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_RESET_IF_RDY
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: If CSTS.RDY = 1, write CC.EN = 0 and wait for CSTS.RDY = 0 (CAP.TO × 500 ms).

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_CONFIG_ADMIN
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Allocate Admin SQ + Admin CQ memory (page-aligned per CC.MPS); write AQA (sizes); ASQ (SQ base); ACQ (CQ base).

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_PROGRAM_CC
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Set CC.MPS, CC.AMS, CC.CSS, CC.IOSQES = 6, CC.IOCQES = 4, CC.SHN = 0, then CC.EN = 1.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_WAIT_READY
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Poll CSTS.RDY until 1 or CAP.TO timeout; on CSTS.CFS=1 abort.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_IDENTIFY
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Identify Controller (CNS = 01h) → discover capabilities (NN, SQES, CQES, MDTS, OAES, ONCS, SGLS, MNAN, ANATT, etc.). Identify NS List (CNS = 02h) → active namespaces.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_SET_FEATURES
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Set Number of Queues (FID = 07h) to request desired I/O SQ/CQ count; controller returns granted counts.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_CREATE_IO_QUEUES
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: For each desired queue pair: Create I/O CQ (OPC = 05h) first, then Create I/O SQ (OPC = 01h).

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_IDENTIFY_NS
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Identify Namespace (CNS = 00h) for each NSID to learn NSZE, NCAP, NUSE, LBAF[], FLBAS, MC, DPC, DPS, NMIC, RESCAP, NGUID, EUI64.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_IO_READY
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Host now issues Read/Write/Flush/Compare/etc. against namespaces via the I/O queue pairs.

fsm_hints.trigger: Host writes SQyTDBL → controller fetches; controller writes CQE + asserts MSI-X → host reads CQE + writes CQyHDBL.
fsm_hints.rule: Controller is always slave at the protocol layer; it does not push unsolicited data — except Asynchronous Event Request completions which require a pre-posted AER command.
fsm_hints.abort: Admin Abort (OPC=08h) with SQID:CID targets a specific outstanding command; controller may complete it normally or with status Command Abort Requested. Up to Abort Command Limit (Identify Controller ACL field) concurrent aborts.

anti_deadlock_rule: Host shall not write SQyTDBL or CQyHDBL with an invalid (out-of-range) value. Doing so while an outstanding Asynchronous Event Request exists raises an asynchronous event 'Invalid Doorbell Write Value' (NCQE.SC = Invalid Doorbell Write Value). The associated queue should be deleted and recreated. The controller continues processing other queues.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on or PCIe Conventional Reset: CC = 0; CSTS.RDY = 0; CSTS.SHST = 00b; all volatile features reset to defaults; persistent features reload from non-volatile storage; PCI Configuration Space is enumerated by BIOS/OS.

default_ready_state_recommendation.CSTS.RDY: 0 — not ready until CC.EN=1 and bring-up succeeds.
default_ready_state_recommendation.Phase Tag: All CQE Phase Tag bits = 0 after CC.EN=0→1 (host expects first pass to invert to 1).

configurations.name: Admin only
configurations.description: CC.CSS = 111b; only Admin Submission Queue accepted; no I/O queues; controller advertises CAP.CSS bit 44 = 1.

configurations.name: Doorbell Stride larger
configurations.description: CAP.DSTRD > 0 reserves space between doorbells; useful for some implementations.

timing_dependency_rule: All in-band ordering is enforced by PCIe TLP ordering (Strong Ordering, Relaxed Ordering, ID-based Ordering bits). A Submission Queue doorbell write must be observed by the controller before it fetches the corresponding SQ entry. A Completion Queue entry write must be observed by the host before the controller asserts the MSI-X interrupt for that completion. Host shall poll CQE Phase Tag (not the controller-internal CQ Tail) to detect new completions, since the controller's CQ Tail Pointer is internal and never directly visible to host.
